resources.string: After Douyin starts, open a chosen friend\'s native pet page once so the pet service is ready. Automatic mode gives only free food; a chosen food is given only when paid food is allowed and its price is within the limit, otherwise that friend is skipped. It works only while Douyin is running and an account is signed in, and sends no messages.
This feature is off. Switch it on in the list after saving.
Only food the service marks free is given; paid food stays off in this mode.
Only the chosen food is given, and only within the price limit.
